scope: Sample-only automatic tmux attachment on transport failures; API 27 ARM64 emulator acceptance. No business integration or Maven publication.

instrumentation.note: Unknown-host-key rejection with non-retry assertion and transport-error classification passed; plain-shell destructive test skipped in tmux mode.

network: Two emulator iptables OUTPUT DROP outages, 66.9s and 66.2s. Each restored the SSH channel and original tmux session without tapping reconnect. Temporary DROP/REJECT test rules removed.
negative_checks: Manual Disconnect and normal tmux detach each observed for 20s: no retries or tmux clients.
limits: Live Activity only; no background service
No device-wide Wi-Fi/cellular switching or real phone test
Header connected means SSH shell channel established, not a separate tmux acknowledgment
Input delivered immediately before failure can be uncertain; no replay across transports
final_change: Added malformed-properties exception handling after the silent-outage tests. Final APK also passed malformed-profile UI handling, abrupt-loss auto-reconnect, and the two applicable instrumentation tests.
